class_year.quote: Expected graduation between December 2027 and June 2029, with sophomore standing or higher.

sponsorship.quote: Optiver is supportive of US immigration sponsorship for this role.

process.quote: We only allow candidates to attempt an assessment at Optiver every 8 months, across all offices and roles. If you have applied to this or a similar role that has the same assessment components within that time frame, the scores from those assessments will carry over until after 8 months from the date of your attempt on that assessment.

cooling_off.quote: Optiver has a global application re-apply policy for our intern and graduate roles. If you have completed an online assessment or interviewed for a quantitative graduate or internship role at any Optiver location in the past 8 months, please note that you are not yet eligible to reapply. We welcome you to re-apply to after the 8-month cool off period.
cooling_off.notes: Scope enum is an imperfect fit and the exact wording should be shown to students rather than the enum. On the Chicago posting the trigger is completing an online assessment OR interviewing (not rejection), and the scope is all Optiver LOCATIONS but only quantitative graduate/internship ROLES. Note the source's own grammatical error, reproduced verbatim: 'We welcome you to re-apply to after the 8-month cool off period.' Three distinct Optiver scope formulations exist and they do not agree: (1) Sydney FAQ, broadest — 'across all offices and roles', immediately qualified by 'this or a similar role that has the same assessment components'; (2) Europe FAQ — 'this role, or a similar role at any of our offices'; (3) Chicago posting — 'a quantitative graduate or internship role at any Optiver location'. Europe FAQ additionally supplies a separate rejection-triggered clock and an anti-gaming rule, verbatim: 'At Optiver, we have an 8-month waiting period for candidates following an unsuccessful application for a similar role.' / 'If you have applied for this role, or a similar role at any of our offices, in the last 8 months and have been unsuccessful, you can reapply once your cooling period has concluded.' / 'Please note: if you reapply before the end of your 8-month cooling period, this will be considered your most recent unsuccessful application.' Retakes, verbatim: 'We understand that technical issues or unforeseen circumstances can be frustrating. However, to ensure a fair and consistent recruitment process for all candidates, we're unable to offer assessment resets or retakes within 8 months once an attempt has been started.' followed by 'This policy applies to all applicants. Making exceptions would be unfair to others progressing through the same process.' And on carry-over of scores, verbatim: 'Please note that assessments can only be completed once every 8 months. If you have already completed the tests for a similar role within this period, your previous results will automatically be used and you will not receive a new assessment invitation.' All from https://www.optiver.com/join-us/stories/optiver-europe-recruitment-faq/ (HTTP 200, verified in raw HTML).
